'''Andrew Liu Andy's Mains & Toys Deck''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Andrew Liu]]
* '''Published:''' November 1998 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Dagobah: Yoda's Hut|Dagobah-L-dagobahyodashut.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Andy's Mains & Toys Deck
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PSE Andy's Mains & Toys Deck Liu LS 1998.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

Andrew Liu of Toronto and his girlfriend, Tiuli Anfossi, each submitted a deck to us. These decks were designed by two players who play against each other all the time, and as Rebel Base Leader puts it, "There's no chance of your falling asleep when these two decks are played against one another."

Divers says, "You can't go wrong - both are set on Tatooine, have lots of mains, and lots of additional cards that answer the complimentary deck blow for blow. Sit down with these decks and you'll have a heck of a game."
